annotation.title_clean: Guide 1. Introduction to the AI Act
annotation.title_en: Guide 1. Introduction to the AI Act
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio para la Transformación Digital y de la Función Pública (Spain)
annotation.venue: Spanish AI regulatory sandbox pilot guides
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Non-binding introductory guide from Spain's digital ministry, produced in the AI regulatory sandbox pilot, explaining the EU AI Act: scope, market surveillance governance, risk tiers, operator roles, SME provisions, sandboxes, main high-risk obligations, application dates, and Spanish authorities for conformity assessment, updated for the Digital Omnibus.
key_provisions_or_claims: Explains AI Act risk tiers: prohibited, high-risk, transparency, other AI.
Annex I product-linked high-risk AI (machinery, medical devices, toys, automotive) follows product conformity assessment.
Outlines high-risk obligations: risk management, data governance, documentation, logging, oversight, robustness, cybersecurity, incident reporting.
Maps Spanish market surveillance authorities (AESIA, others) per product/sector under the draft national AI law.
Updated to reflect Digital Omnibus changes, e.g., AI literacy and SME/SMC relief and revised application dates.
